stage: Frozen external missing-region baseline screen; not a proposed novel method
seed_interpretation: Deterministic eval-mode generator; 17 fixes initialization and identifies reused diffusion controls, not a claim of independent seed replication
model: Author RefFaceInpainting netG with exact author ArcFace R101 and author BiSeNet19 reference parser; all strict-loaded. No training or architecture changes.
processing: Native 256 RGB normalized [-1,1], missing-mask adaptive max pooling. Erased original pixels replaced by constant128 before bilinear RGB downsampling. Reference parser receives only supplied reference RGB at512 with ImageNet normalization; argmax labels nearest-resized to256. Output bilinear-upsampled to512 then original outside-mask bytes copied exactly. Upsampling is not native512 synthesis.
reference_policy: Each of the four supplied references separately. Reference0 is the fixed primary choice by existing manifest order, frozen before generation. No target/gallery scoring or best-of-four selection at inference; all four outputs retained and reference sensitivity reported descriptively.
computation: 16 new author-model predictions including one reference parsing pass each; 12 unchanged controls reused (ResShiftseed17, corrected ReFLDMseed17, damaged observation). Different reference counts/architectures; not equal total compute. Record latency and memory.
evaluation: Same separate FaceNet target and three-gallery evaluator, diagnostic ArcFace, LPIPS SSIM PSNR hole/visibleMAE NIQE BRISQUE and detector coverage. ArcFace conditions this author model; do not use its scores as independent identity evidence.
statistics: Four prespecified paired contrasts: fixed reference0 versus each of two reconstruction controls for FaceNet and holeMAE. Exact identity sign-flips with Holm correction, identity bootstrap, missing detections retained; all four reference choices secondary and not independent identity units.
decision: This baseline can establish a reproducible missing-region comparator only. No novelty, website promotion or adapter-training gate follows. Any subsequent mechanism must be separately specified and confirmed on independent development identities; no posthoc best-reference selection or threshold tuning.
inference_scope: Only observation, missing mask, supplied references; no clean target, gallery, target parsing, target landmarks or target identity vector
